cards.title: Boundary Record
cards.description: Coupled system boundary, spatial scale, time scale, and external flows.

cards.title: Human-System Record
cards.description: Population, demand, livelihoods, infrastructure, institutions, behavior, technology, inequality, and adaptive capacity.

cards.title: Natural-System Record
cards.description: Resource stocks, regeneration, ecosystem condition, habitat, climate stress, biodiversity, water, soil, and thresholds.

cards.title: Coupling Record
cards.description: Extraction, restoration, emissions, exposure, feedback, trade, leakage, displacement, and governance response.

cards.title: Governance Record
cards.description: Rules, legitimacy, enforcement, capacity, participation, monitoring, and accountability.

cards.title: Equity Record
cards.description: Exposure, access, benefit, burden, rights, culture, participation, and vulnerability.

cards.title: Claim Boundary
cards.description: Teaching, exploratory scenarios, planning, policy analysis, or decision support.
